product.amstrad-integra-486.summary: The entry-level 486 Integra, also sold as the Premier with extra software.
product.amstrad-integra-486.history: Amstrad positioned the 486 as the entry point to the home Integra range. Its 1996 British brochure offered the PC/TV at £899 and the Premier with applications and games at £949, both plus VAT.
product.amstrad-integra-486.technical.co: The supplied memory varied between offers. Personal Computer World reported 4 MB in February 1996 and the later Amstrad Direct brochure advertised 8 MB for both 486 packages.
product.amstrad-integra-486.technical.ve: The configuration has been checked against contemporary sources. The BluMach sheet is in research.
product.amstrad-integra-486.technical.li: An attributable system BIOS, motherboard identification and validation of boot, TV tuner and remote control remain pending.
